 TG 209 F3 Tarsus - Proteus Software
 The TG 209 F3 Tarsus runs under Proteus Software on Windows operating system. The Proteus Software includes everything
 you need to carry out a measurement and evaluate the resulting data. Through the combination of easy-to-understand menus
 and automated routines, a tool has been created that is extremely user-friendly and, at the same time, allows sophisticated ana-
 lysis. The Proteus Software is licensed with the instrument and can of course be installed on other computer systems.
